newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy recovering gradually despite tax-BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy recovering gradually despite tax-BOJ.

text.p: Japan's economy is continuing its gradual recovery despite the negative effects of a rise in its consumption tax on April 1, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Friday in its monthly report.

"A drop in demand in reaction to an increase preceding the tax rise has been detected," the central bank said, adding that "production and private income continued to be firm and the economy as a whole is continuing its gradual recovery".

The BOJ also said consumption has been falling in reaction to the tax rise, but when taking into account improvements in employment conditions and income, the recovery trend in private consumption is unlikely to be hindered.
The report also said Japan's net exports were continuing to rise on the back of firm demand overseas and the weakening of the yen.
It also said Japan's current account surplus was rising, but added that the pace of increase has been gradual, reflecting high crude oil prices.
